items.title: Albert "June" Gardner Interview, 1996-04-17
items.q: The interviewer mentions C-SENG in the context of an album, but the interviewee does not mention C-SENG directly or describe any personal interaction, collaboration, or relationship with them.

ctx.x: Born Under the Bad Sign. Bad Sign, yeah, I'm on that. I was on that one. That was in like early 80s with C-SENG, yeah. Yeah.

And I see it when I was working over at the Sazerac. I see Allen all the time and he'd say, hey, he's going to get in touch with me. We're going to do this and that. But well, if the phone rings, it's okay. You know, that type of thing. Yeah, I know. I say right now I just stay out of the politics of the business, you know.
